**Not for security flaws.** Anything that lets money be created, spent twice or
frozen, or that stops a node dead on a message anyone can send it, goes to
https://github.com/cairnchain/cairn/security/advisories/new instead.

## How to get back to it

The smallest sequence you know of that reaches it. If you only have the long
one, give the long one.

## Where

- Version: (`cairnd --version`, or the commit if you built it yourself)
- Operating system:
- Network: mainnet / testnet / your own

## What it printed

Paste the output rather than describing it, including the lines before the one
that looks wrong. If a node stopped, the paragraph it printed on the way out is
the important part.
